clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, maps and runes point to Dalaran's interest in Ambermill. A hidden crate holds regional charts and a rune-inscribed pendant, which adventurers recover for Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.

Horde agents find a Dalaran crate hidden along the border routes near Ambermill. Inside are detailed regional charts and an enigmatic pendant inscribed with runes. With human sentries nearby, the scouts retrieve the artifact carefully, wary of Dalaran's arcane reach so close to their borders.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you learned anything useful, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Maps and this... Pendant, hm? Interesting.
It is obvious that the Dalaran wizards are interested in Ambermill for some purpose, but still, their aim is hidden to me.
Perhaps Dalar will know something of their use.
